en: The approach, from outside the east gate
cap: Where the man with the measuring reed stood (40:6). The whole 500-cubit axis: outer gate, outer court, inner gate, the altar, the House.
Fifty cubits deep, twenty-five across (40:21,13). Three guardrooms a side, six cubits square, five cubits between them (40:7,10,12). The blue figure against the right-hand wall is 1.80 m tall.
Twelve by twelve at the hearth, fourteen by fourteen at the settle, each stage stepping in one cubit (43:14-17). Its steps look toward the east (43:17).
The porch twenty long and eleven broad (40:49); the Heichal forty by twenty (41:2); the Holy of Holies twenty by twenty (41:4). Side chambers in three tiers (41:5-6).

en: The whole precinct, five hundred cubits square
he: כל המקדש, חמש מאות אמה על חמש מאות
cap: Four gates alike on four sides (40:20-37), a hundred cubits from gate to gate (40:23), the inner court a hundred square (40:47).
